'''House Lanar''' was one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]], and a vassal house to [[House of Thul|House Thul]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before House Thul's exile. When House Thul returned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Lanar turned on Thul and attacked them, causing House Thul and its backers in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] to wipe out House Lanar's leaders. House Lanar's soldiers became [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who preyed on House Thul with the help of the local populace. During the fighting, an imperial killed [[Rangos Lanar]].<ref name="TOR" />
